竞标时间分为30、45、60、75、90、120秒。复杂度由必选能力等级与数量、: Bidding windows are 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 or 120 seconds. Complexity combines mandatory levels and counts, additional specialties, alternative paths, completed-project experience, net cash and crew requirements. Solo and joint bids share one deadline. The window locks at release; later upgrades do not change it. Existing listings retain their deadlines.
按复杂度30–120秒密封竞标，截止前可修改撤回；不预留现金。符合经营资格和资金: Sealed bids stay open for 30–120s according to complexity; edit or withdraw before closing, without reserving cash. Lowest eligible offers passing simulated funding checks win; equal offers use a fair random draw. Public magnitude ranges are not price caps; internal estimates and available funding remain private. Costs follow milestones and receipts follow certification delays; shortages hold work. Complete safety before 25% and documents before 55%; Lv.6 automates checks on new awards. Missed safety causes 12s hold, 2-unit remediation and a 6% base-cost claim (reduced by insurance). Missed documents cost 3 units and delay unpaid/future receipts 18s.
这是参考美国联邦密封投标程序的游戏模拟，不覆盖所有美国采购，也未模拟全部法定资格: This simulation simulation references US federal sealed bidding; it does not cover all US procurement or every statutory procedure. Capabilities, gates, probabilities, delays and fees are simulation parameters.
投标和开标时，合并本次项目与已承接项目的成本、回款及审核延迟、检查费用、管理费用: At bidding and award, combine the proposed project and existing commitments: costs, delayed receipts, check fees and management overhead. Require cash covering the maximum projected deficit. Budget a 20% material shock reduced by quality, never the hidden actual shock. At equal times, count costs before receipts. Use current capabilities, fatigue and known holds; exclude unsecured loans, unsigned contracts, future interest and upgrades. Loss-making bids may win if cash covers the projection. Bids do not reserve cash; award rechecks funding. Later discretionary spending or new risks can still cause shortages. Bots no longer bid a fixed 1% of cost; low-skill bots underestimate costs.
管理费/经营分钟=(1+1.5L+0.25L²)×(1−0.04C)，L为新增施: Management cost per game minute = (1 + 1.5L + 0.25L²) × (1 − 0.04C), where L is added-crew level and C coordination. It accrues each second and is charged each minute, including idle time. One full trading round represents one year. At a 4% annual nominal rate, per-second interest = max(cash − debt − unfinished advances, 0) × 0.04 ÷ round duration in seconds. Accrued interest enters cash and profit each minute, not revenue; credited interest can earn interest. Preparation, pauses and post-game exit time do not accrue. Early endings earn only elapsed time; remaining overhead and interest settle at end or game exit.
新版经营平衡：材料冲击0%、4%或8%，质量能力减免；资金审核仍保留20%压力缓: New-round balance: material shocks are 0%, 4% or 8%, reduced by quality; funding reviews retain a 20% stress buffer. Overhead is 35% of the original baseline; upgrade buttons show actual prices. Stage probabilities for open/basic/advanced are 100/0/0, 50/50/0, 20/35/45 and 10/25/65. Exhausted categories fall back to other unlocked projects. Extra manual host releases have no batch or open-project count limit. Awards and profit are not guaranteed.
开标后，实际投标公司收到侧边结果通知，显示投标成功或失败、中标公司及合同金额；联: After opening, bidders receive a sidebar result with success or failure, the winner and contract amount. Both joint partners are notified. No-award and cancellation results are identified; dismissed notices stay dismissed on this device.
跨专业专项分级解锁：第二阶段30个，要求主专业2级、另一专业1级、协调1级，无经: Cross-specialty packages unlock progressively: stage 2 has 30 with primary specialty Lv.2, secondary Lv.1 and coordination Lv.1, without experience or net-cash gates. Stage 3 adds 35 requiring primary Lv.3, secondary Lv.2, coordination Lv.2 and net cash 10. Stage 4 adds 35 requiring primary Lv.4–5, secondary Lv.3, coordination Lv.3, one completed project, net cash 20 and either quality Lv.3 or safety Lv.3 plus compliance Lv.2. Solo offers use the company’s own qualifications; joint offers use combined capabilities with individual funding and crew checks. Bidding time follows project complexity. Counts describe the catalog, not guaranteed releases; easier projects remain eligible later.
100条预设虚构新闻，五大专业各20条；正式经营每隔25–50秒随机发布2–5条: 100 fictional preset events, 20 per specialty. Every 25–50 trading seconds, 2–5 events appear, each lasting 45–120s. Batches favor different specialties; events do not repeat and stop after the 100-event pool is exhausted. Cost events affect milestones paid during the window; receipt events affect newly triggered receipts, not already certified amounts. Work events temporarily change progress speed. Demand events change owner estimates and funding only on newly released projects; actual revenue still depends on winning bids, and existing listings/contracts stay unchanged. Combined caps: costs/demand ±8%, speed ±10%, receipt delay ±10s with minimum 0. Preparation and pauses freeze the news clock; history remains in debrief.

Health & growth = growth 35% + cash flow 35% + employees 30%. Performance has fixed targets: revenue of 12 units per trading minute and 25% margin, rather than comparison with the current leader.
